name: Adspy
description: Hosted Adspy (adspy.sh) MCP server for researching brands' public Meta and Google ads and their organic TikTok, YouTube and Instagram posts: search ads, read their available creative analysis, compare brands and see which posts later ran as ads. Answers come with counts and dates, never with spend or ROAS; TikTok ads are not covered. Requires a paid Adspy plan; sign in with OAuth.
author: Adspy
